dishes.name: Lemon and Seed Morning Oats
dishes.title: Porridge with lemon zest and sunflower seeds
dishes.method: Simmer the oats and milk in a small pan until creamy. Stir in the lemon zest and top with sunflower seeds.
dishes.why: A warm, zesty start that avoids tree nuts while providing steady energy for the day.

dishes.name: Golden Seed Butter Toast
dishes.title: Toasted bread with sunflower seed butter
dishes.method: Toast the bread until golden and spread generously with the sunflower seed butter.
dishes.why: I have swapped the requested nut butter for sunflower seed butter to keep the entire household safe from medical allergens.

dishes.name: Zesty Nut-Free Oats
dishes.title: Porridge with lemon zest and sunflower seeds
dishes.method: Simmer the oats and milk in a pan. Stir in the lemon zest and top with the seeds, ensuring no cross-contamination with nuts.
dishes.why: A safe, nut-free breakfast that provides the energy needed for a large lunch later.

dishes.name: Sizzling Beef & Pepper Rice
dishes.title: Stir-fried beef and peppers with fluffy rice
dishes.method: Reheat a portion of the beef and pepper mix in a pan until piping hot. Serve over the reheated rice.
dishes.why: A high-protein lunch with vibrant peppers to meet the loud vegetable requirement.

dishes.name: Hearty Beef & Pepper Power Bowl
dishes.title: Stir-fried beef and peppers with rice
dishes.method: Reheat the beef and rice in a pan. Ensure a larger portion of both for muscle gain support.
dishes.why: Extra starch and protein at lunch to fuel the day's activity.

dishes.name: Vibrant Beef & Pepper Stir-fry
dishes.title: Stir-fried beef and peppers with rice
dishes.method: Reheat the beef and peppers in a pan. Serve with a smaller portion of rice and extra peppers.
dishes.why: Focuses on generous vegetables and full protein while managing starch intake.

dishes.name: Zesty Lemon Chicken & Mash
dishes.title: Pan-seared lemon chicken with courgettes and potato mash
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and courgettes in a pan with a splash of water. Warm the mash in a separate pan and serve.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting dinner that avoids the broken oven by using the hob.

dishes.name: Muscle-Fuel Lemon Chicken & Mash
dishes.title: Lemon chicken and courgettes with extra mash
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and a generous portion of mash in pans until hot. Serve with the seared courgettes.
dishes.why: Increased protein and starch for recovery and muscle growth.

dishes.name: Garden-Fresh Lemon Chicken & Mash
dishes.title: Lemon chicken with extra courgettes and mash
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and courgettes. Serve with a small portion of mash, ensuring no fennel or nuts are present.
dishes.why: A safe dinner focusing on generous portions of the 'loud' green vegetable.

preparations.title: Steamed Basmati Rice
preparations.method: Rinse the rice. Boil in salted water for 10-12 minutes until tender. Drain and fluff with a fork.

preparations.title: Sizzling Beef and Bell Peppers
preparations.method: Slice peppers into strips. Sear the beef in a hot pan with oil until browned. Add peppers and fry for 5 minutes until tender-crisp.

preparations.title: Lemon and Seed Pan-Seared Chicken
preparations.method: Slice courgettes into rounds. Sear chicken thighs in a pan until cooked through. Add courgettes, lemon juice, and sunflower seeds for the last 5 minutes.

preparations.title: Smooth Potato Mash
preparations.method: Peel and boil potatoes until soft. Drain and mash thoroughly with olive oil and a pinch of salt.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the rice and potatoes boiling in separate pots. While they cook, slice the peppers and courgettes. Sear the beef and peppers in a large pan, then box. Sear the chicken, courgettes, and seeds in the same pan with lemon. Drain and mash the potatoes. Box all components separately for the day's meals.
